tvShow.name: Bigg Boss Telugu
tvShow.overview: The Telugu version of the reality show where a number of contestants (known as "housemates") live in a purpose-built house and are isolated from the rest of the world. Each week, housemates nominate two of their fellow housemates for eviction, and the housemates who receive the most nominations faces a public vote out.

episodes.name: Jr. NTR Welcomes The Contestants
episodes.overview: Young heart-throb, Jr. NTR welcomes each of fourteen contestants. He then takes the viewers on a tour inside the much-talked about Bigg Boss House.

episodes.name: New Captain, New Drama
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss nominates a house captain. Later, Bigg Boss asks the housemates to nominate two people out of the show, and gives the inmates a task to make a confession about themselves.

episodes.name: Aadarsh, Dhanraj's Shocking Prank
episodes.overview: The contestants get their personal belongings and later, Aadarsh and Dhanraj pull off a shocking prank!

episodes.name: A Secret Task For Sameer
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss asks Sameer to secretly prevent some contestants' luggage from reaching them. Meanwhile, Hari Teja, Adarsh and Prince get into an argument.

episodes.name: Will Mumaith Perform?
episodes.overview: Sampoornesh is removed from the captaincy and Mumaith is given the responsibility of learning the language. Bigg Boss awaits Mumaith's performance!

episodes.name: No Smoking!
episodes.overview: Mumaith Khan and Kalpana compete in a water sport task. Cigarettes are denied to the contestants as the rules of the smoking room were not followed. What will this lead to?

episodes.name: Elimination Or Celebration?
episodes.overview: Jr NTR is here again, but unfortunately, to eliminate a contestant! However, an elimination round turns into a celebration in the house.

episodes.name: First Elimination!
episodes.overview: After a week's stay in the house among all the craziness and fun, who will be the first one to bid adieu? Will it be Mahesh, Hari Teja or Jyothi?

episodes.name: A Romantic Task!
episodes.overview: The contestants give their eviction nominations for the week and perform a romantic task assigned by Bigg Boss!

episodes.name: Sampoornesh Babu Exits The Show!
episodes.overview: Hell breaks loose when an insane Sampoornesh Babu threatens the Big Boss team for his release! Why?

episodes.name: Who Are The Lucky Three?
episodes.overview: Only three contestants impress Bigg Boss in the assigned task. Later, Shiva Balaji complains about Kalpana's behaviour to Bigg Boss.

episodes.name: Mumaith Khan Leaves!
episodes.overview: The other contestants are stunned as Bigg Boss asks Mumaith Khan to leave the house. What is the reason behind her eviction?

episodes.name: Race Gurram Task!
episodes.overview: Big Boss assigns a dawdling task for Kalpana, Prince and Shiva Balaji. The contestant who manages to rock the horse till the last minute wins!

episodes.name: Kalpana, The Villain Of The Show!
episodes.overview: Jr. NTR unveils a sword throne and asks everyone to nominate the villain in the house. Kalpana gets nominated as the villain many times. Is she in danger?

episodes.name: Wild Card Entry!
episodes.overview: Madhu Priya exits the show and shares her experience. Brace yourself as Bigg Boss introduces a wild card entry in the house.

episodes.name: Safe Zone Nominations
episodes.overview: The contestants are amused to see Diksha Panth in the house. Bigg Boss asks the contestants to nominate two people to be in the safe zone.

episodes.name: Mumaith's Never-ending Problems
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a role-play task to the contestants. Mumaith Khan causes commotion and pulls a fight with Prince and Shiv Balaji, who end up fighting with each other. Why?

episodes.name: Prince Kisses Diksha
episodes.overview: Hari Teja is low after a quarrel with her team mates. Prince and his team win the luxury budget task. Later, he surprises a shy Diksha Panth with a kiss.

episodes.name: Mumaith's Moving Gesture
episodes.overview: Kalpana and Diksha fight over a past incident. Bigg Boss assigns a task to the contestants. Later, Mumaith does something which moves everyone to tears.

episodes.name: Shut Up, Mumaith Khan!
episodes.overview: Big Boss instructs Prince to plaster Mumaith Khan's mouth. Later, there is commotion in the house because of Mumaith.

episodes.name: Raksha Bandhan Celebration!
episodes.overview: The housemates celebrate Raksha Bandhan in the house and later, Jr NTR announces the names of the contestants who are saved from eviction!

episodes.name: Rana Visits The Show
episodes.overview: Rana visits the Bigg Boss house and unveils the name of the contestant walking out this week. Who will it be?

episodes.name: Kalpana Under Pressure?
episodes.overview: Everyone in the house is assigned a funny task and the house captain, Adarsh is asked to monitor them. Later, Bigg Boss asks the members to vote out two contestants with appropriate reasons. Will Kalpana get targetted again?

episodes.name: Shiva Balaji Insults Adarsh
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss divides the contestants into two teams and sets up Simhasanas in the house. Later, Shiva Balaji insults Adarsh till the latter breaks down.

episodes.name: Who Are The Worst Four?
episodes.overview: Four contestants are punished for their poor performance in the last few tasks. Who are they and what's the punishment?

episodes.name: Hello, Who's This?
episodes.overview: Mahesh Kathi and Adarsh's misunderstanding results in an argument in the house. Later, everyone is excited as they get to speak with their family over the phone.

episodes.name: Who Is The New Captain?
episodes.overview: Hari Teja and Adarsh nominate themselves to get a phone call from their family members. Mumaith Khan, Karthika, Hari Teja and Shiva Balaji contest for the house captain post. Who will win the captaincy?

episodes.name: Another Inmate Evicted
episodes.overview: N. T. Rama Rao Jr. unveils the contestant's name whose journey comes to an end this week. Who is it?

episodes.name: One In, One Out
episodes.overview: Jr NTR announces the name of the evicted contestant and welcomes a new contestant as a wild card entry.

episodes.name: Navdeep Begins His Stay
episodes.overview: The newest member of the house, Navdeep begins his stay and the contestants give their eviction nominations for the week.

episodes.name: Independence Day Celebrations
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss assigns the contestants to set up a hotel in the house and asks Navdeep and Diksha to be the guests. Later, the Independence Day celebrations begin.

episodes.name: The Royal Luxury Budget Task
episodes.overview: In this luxury budget task, the contestants take good care of Navdeep and Diksha. Later, Bigg Boss assigns a secret task to Prince. Meanwhile, Shiva Balaji is mighty annoyed. Why?

episodes.name: Taapsee Pannu In The House
episodes.overview: Star actress Taapsee Pannu visits the house to promote her latest movie, Anando Brahma and has some fun with the contestants.

episodes.name: The Going Gets Tough
episodes.overview: Mumaith fights for captaincy against Navdeep. Bigg Boss gives the contestants a tough task. While performing it some of the contestants hurt themselves and start bleeding.

episodes.name: Dhanraj's Hilarious Mimicry
episodes.overview: NTR Jr plays musical chair with the contestants. Dhanraj imitates the contestant's temperament in the house. Later, the host announces two contestants to be safe. Who are those two?

episodes.name: Twists And Turns for Mumaith
episodes.overview: NTR Jr asks Mumaith to pack her luggage and leave the house. Later, Bigg Boss plays a fair game and calls her back to the stage. What's the plan of action now?

episodes.name: Surprising Evictions
episodes.overview: The contestants vote out Shiva Balaji and Archana, who don't take it too kindly. Later, Bigg Boss assigns a selfie task to the contestants.

episodes.name: New Task for Mumaith
episodes.overview: The contestants are stunned when a few robbers steal almost everything from the house. Bigg Boss has a special task for Mumaith Khan.

episodes.name: Mumaith Is Back!
episodes.overview: Mumaith surprises everyone with a dramatic entry. She berates Dhanraj for his double game in front of everyone which drives him to tears.

episodes.name: Archana Does A Pole Dance!
episodes.overview: Hari Teja and Mumaith compete for captaincy. Archana performs a pole dance and amazes everyone. Later, 'Arjun Reddy' Vijay enters the house.

episodes.name: Lord Ganesha In the House
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss asks Navdeep to dress up like Lord Ganesha and offer solutions to the contestants' problems. The contestants celebrate Ganesha Chathurthi.

episodes.name: Double Danger
episodes.overview: Jr NTR tells the contestants about the elimination twist. Contestants Dhanraj, Kathi Karthika and Archana are in the danger zone. Who gets eliminated?

episodes.name: Second Eviction of the Week
episodes.overview: Dhanraj visits the house again. Jr NTR announces the name of the second contestant to get evicted this week. Who will it be?

episodes.name: Mumaith Turns Rogue
episodes.overview: Friction builds amid contestants when they have to vote out two contestants. Mumaith's raspy behaviour annoys the housemates. Hari Teja denies safeguarding Mumaith from eliminations.

episodes.name: Culture Fest in The House
episodes.overview: In this cultural task, the contestants dress up and dance according to the cities in Andhra Pradesh. The housemates complete the task enthusiastically.

episodes.name: The Hilarious Hari Katha
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a task every time the contestants reach a particular destination on the map. Later, Hari Teja steals the show with a self-composed Hari Katha.

episodes.name: Balloon War for Captaincy
episodes.overview: The housemates get emotional as Bigg Boss reminds them of their childhood. Everyone is asked to fight for team captaincy with balloons. Will Mumaith crack it this time?

episodes.name: Mumaith's Birthday Celebrations
episodes.overview: The contestants compete in the CEAT challenge. Actor Sachin visits the house and plays truth or dare. Mumaith Khan celebrates her birthday!

episodes.name: Suma Visits the House
episodes.overview: Popular anchor Suma visits and says that she has come to inspect the Bigg Boss house. Later, Jr NTR announces the names of contestants who are free from eviction!

episodes.name: Who Will Exit The Show?
episodes.overview: N. T. Rama Rao Jr. makes the contestants play Dumb Charades in a different way before announcing the name of the exiting housemate. Mumaith, Archana, and Diksha fret when the name is announced!

episodes.name: Ghost in Bigg Boss House?
episodes.overview: Diksha wins the captaincy by a majority of votes. Later, the housemates are asked to vote out two people, but soon some paranormal activities take place in the house!

episodes.name: Adarsh, Prince Lock Horns
episodes.overview: During the luxury budget task, Adarsh and Prince have a clash. Later, Bigg Boss plays a video clip of the housemates, summing up their journey so far, in the house.

episodes.name: Let's Get Back to School Life
episodes.overview: Diksha and Hari Teja are asked to play the role of teachers while other housemates are asked to play the role of primary school students. A group of kids visit Big Boss house and spend quality time with the contestants.

episodes.name: Allari Naresh Visits the House
episodes.overview: Allari Naresh visits the show and auditions the contestants. Big Boss assigns numerous tasks to the housemates in order to win the captaincy. Who will win the captaincy for the second time?

episodes.name: Time for Appraisals
episodes.overview: Big Boss asks the contestants to do a self-analysis and stand on the ranking podium accordingly. How will the contestants appraise themselves?

episodes.name: A Tricky Elimination
episodes.overview: Jr NTR calls the contestants to the confession room and asks them to choose the person they want to eliminate. What will be the result?

episodes.name: A Surprising Eviction
episodes.overview: Jr NTR organises a Kabaddi game in the house with some interesting new rules. Later, he announces the name of the evicted contestant. Who will it be?

episodes.name: Diksha Is in Trouble
episodes.overview: All the contestants nominate Diksha to exit the show. Later, Dhanraj, Mahesh Kathi, Karthika and Sampoornesh Babu surprise the contestants.

episodes.name: A Big Surprise for Adarsh!
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss plays the freeze and unfreeze game with the contestants. Shiva gets emotional as his wife visits him. Later, a big surprise awaits Adarsh in the confession room.

episodes.name: Archana Gets Emotional
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss continues the freeze and unfreeze game and gives pleasant surprises to Archana, Hari Teja and Navdeep! Later, someone steals their food.

episodes.name: Diksha, Archana Lock Horns
episodes.overview: Shiv Balaji and the housemates enjoy the fight between Diksha and Archana over a petty issue. Celebrity Sunil visits the house and promotes his upcoming movie, Ungarala Rambabu.

episodes.name: Diksha's Joy is Short-lived
episodes.overview: Big Boss asks everyone to reveal their favourite spot in the house with reasons. Diksha gets close to Archana until she eavesdrops on her!

episodes.name: N. T. Rama Rao Jr. in the House
episodes.overview: The housemates are in for a surprise as NTR Jr. himself visits the house along with Niveth Thomas, Raashi Khanna and his brother, Nandamuri Kalyan Ram to promote his most-awaited movie, Jai Lava Kusa!

episodes.name: Pretty Stiff Competition
episodes.overview: NTR Jr. takes leave after whipping up some delicious Mutton Biryani for the contestants. Later, he announces the name of the evicted contestant. Will it be Diksha or Archana?

episodes.name: Last Week in the House
episodes.overview: As the housemates begin the final week of the season, Bigg Boss asks them to request the audience to vote for them. Will they impress the audience?

episodes.name: An Unusual Task
episodes.overview: Every individual pays a visit to the play area as and when Bigg Boss calls out their name. While they are jittery as they enter the play area, as they exit they are all emotional. Why?

episodes.name: Astrologer in the House
episodes.overview: Captain Archana becomes the center of attraction as Bigg Boss assigns a task to the male contestants. Later, an astrologer predicts the future of the contestants. How does their future look?

episodes.name: Time for a Make-over
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss asks the 5 finalists to take part in the next challenge. Later, they get a make-over from top stylists.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Face-off
episodes.overview: The finalists are ecstatic after getting a make-over. Later, they are in for a surprise as one by one the eliminated contestants make a re-entry.

episodes.name: Last Day in the House
episodes.overview: All participants take leave after wishing the finalists. The public interacts with the finalists over a video call. Later, each finalist has a surprise in the confession room.

episodes.name: And The Winner Is
episodes.overview: Tarak begins the finale episode with a bang. Devi Sri Prasad spices up the entertainment quotient, followed by peppy performances by Prince, Diksha, Madhupriya and others. After a roller coaster 70-days in the house, who will walk out as the winner?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: For season one, a lavish house set has been constructed in Lonavla.

episodes.name: Nani Kickstarts Bigg Boss 2
episodes.overview: Natural star Nani kicks off Season 2 with 16 interesting housemates, all set to begin their journey in the Bigg Boss house for the next 106 days. And guess what, Day Zero has already seen a couple of nominations.

episodes.name: Day 1 in the House
episodes.overview: Sanjana is mighty disappointed at being forced to stay in the jail. The inmates prefer to get Nutan out of the jail. Deepthi Sunaina, Ganesh and Sanjana get nominated as the inmates gear up for the first elimination. Who will Syamala and Amit nominate?

episodes.name: Day 2 in the House
episodes.overview: Bigg boss releases Sanjana from the jail. A luxury budget task 'Cheppandi Prabhu' is assigned to the inmates. Sanjana's team plays the part of the owners. Soon a situation of contention sets in within her team over assigning tasks to the servants' team.

episodes.name: Day 3 in the House
episodes.overview: Team Sevakalu put up a unique fashion show and walk the ramp, cross-dressing in style. Bigg Boss takes the teams by surprise by changing the rules of the task. Kireeti gets emotional and sheds tears in solitude. Why?

episodes.name: Day 4 in the House
episodes.overview: Just five days into the house, the contestants start having serious disagreements with each other. With a secret mission that promises captaincy, which contestant will take up the task?

episodes.name: Day 5 in the House
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss initiates the battle for captaincy and asks the housemates to select four names. They are given a task to entertain the housemates with some quirky props provided. Who will seize the opportunity to become 'captain'?

episodes.name: Day 6 in the House
episodes.overview: Nani asks each of the contestants to pick up an envelope and read out the dialogues inside them to the most suitable person in the house. He berates Samrat's captaincy in front of the housemates.

episodes.name: Day 7 in the House
episodes.overview: The contestants get emotional, celebrating Father's Day in the house. Nutan and Sanjana are on the brink of getting eliminated while a new contestant is all set to enter the house.

episodes.name: Day 8 in the House
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss instructs the contestants to pair up and nominate others for elimination. The new member, Nandini introduces herself and tries to blend in with the housemates.

episodes.name: Day 9 in the House
episodes.overview: The contestants gear up to perform the new task announced in the house. Kaushal and Geetha have an ugly argument while the contestants compete with each other in the task.

episodes.name: Day 10 in the House
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss warns the captain, Samrat for violating the rules of the house. Hell breaks loose as Geetha and Tanish get into an intense argument. Nutan and Deepthi serve jail time.

episodes.name: Day 11 in the House
episodes.overview: Famed comedians, Vennela Kishore and Srinivas Reddy entertain the housemates and promote their upcoming movie, Jamba Lakidi Pamba. However, the joy is short-lived as Bigg Boss ruthlessly punishes the housemates.

episodes.name: Day 12 in the House
episodes.overview: From organizing their beds to following food netiquettes, the contestants start getting bugged with each other's mannerisms and decide to voice their concern. With the second captaincy up for grabs, who will seize the opportunity?

episodes.name: Day 13 in the House
episodes.overview: Tanish and Deepthi Sunaina are not in host, Nani's good books. One of the inmates vents out his frustration at being targeted. Also, find out which contestants are safe from elimination this week?

episodes.name: Day 14 in the House
episodes.overview: The housemates enjoy a fun activity and reveal their buddies in the Bigg Boss house. But will the threat of elimination burst their bubble of assumptions?

episodes.name: Day 15 in the House
episodes.overview: After Nutan Naidu's elimination, the contestants start patching their differences, hoping to turn over a new leaf. However, their plans go awry when a mistake leads to an unexpected open elimination.

episodes.name: Day 16 in the House
episodes.overview: Rumble arises in the house as Bigg Boss divides the contestants into two teams to perform a production task. Samrat causes damage to the Bigg Boss property while Bhanu breaks into tears.

episodes.name: Day 17 in the House
episodes.overview: Kireeti and Kaushal bribe their workers, while Tejaswi has a game plan to earn extra income. Bigg Boss unveils the winner of the luxury budget task. Who are the winners?

episodes.name: Day 18 in the House
episodes.overview: Mayhem breaks out as Tejaswi and Syamala get into an ugly fight. Tears well up in the house as the contestants talk about love and sacrifice.

episodes.name: Day 19: Ready, Steady, Chomp!
episodes.overview: With the captaincy on the line, Ganesh, Roll Rida and Kireeti prepare to wolf down huge crates of Biryani to win the challenge. Who will chomp to be the champ?

episodes.name: Day 20: Excitement Amidst the Tension
episodes.overview: Nani enquires Tejaswi about her emotional breakdowns and plays a small game of 'Aeyara Dharuvu' with the contestants. With five housemates in the danger zone this week, who will be saved by the audience?

episodes.name: Day 21: Nani Erupts Tension in the House
episodes.overview: Nani and the housemates play an interesting 'Yes or No' game before erasing a contestant's name from the roster of the Bigg Boss House. Who bids goodbye tonight?

episodes.name: Day 22: Mayhem In Bigg Boss House
episodes.overview: Amit and Tanish take the contestants on an emotional rollercoaster ride by executing a secret task. The housemates pair up and nominate two contestants for the elimination. Who will get blacklisted this week?

episodes.name: Day 23: In Love And War
episodes.overview: Love is in the air as the Bigg Boss house turns into a lover's nest. Witness the catfight as the ladies in the house wage a war against each other.

episodes.name: Day 24: Love And Its Restrictions
episodes.overview: With the Lovers Hostel task bringing out the inner romantic in everyone, the couples go all out to convey their love to their significant other. Tune in to find out what hilarious antics the housemates pull to achieve their goal.

episodes.name: Day 25: Sai Dharam Tej in the House
episodes.overview: Tejaswi is on cloud nine as Sai Dharam Tej and Anupama join the housemates and celebrate her birthday. The guests talk to the housemates about their upcoming movie.

episodes.name: Day 26: Royal Rumble in the House
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss penalizes Samrat for his actions after the housemates get into a nasty fight, contesting for captaincy. While Nandini receives a surprise, Deepthi experiences turbulence.

episodes.name: Day 27: Burying the Rumors
episodes.overview: The week sees a lot of rumors and fabricated stories flying around the Bigg Boss house. Join Nani, as he confronts the housemates and gets to the end of these baseless rumors.

episodes.name: Day 28: An Emotional Elimination
episodes.overview: Nani plays an intriguing game of 'who's the villain' with the contestants. Tune in to witness abrupt emotional outbursts as one among the nominated leaves the house.

episodes.name: Day 29: Bigg Boss Unmasks the Contestants
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss assigns a dicey telephone booth task to the contestants in order to shed light on their true colours. What repercussions will it have as friendship and bonds start to collapse?

episodes.name: Day 30: Bhanu Meets With an Accident
episodes.overview: The house turns black and white as Bigg Boss selects the angels and demons of the house. The housemates are aghast as Bhanu agonises in pain.

episodes.name: Day 31: Angels Vs Demons
episodes.overview: Friendship and love seems to be lost as misunderstandings peak amid the housemates. Roll Rida loses his cool and berates Bhanu and Tejaswi. Why?

episodes.name: Day 32: Violence in the House
episodes.overview: Violence explodes in the Bigg Boss house as the arguments between Bhanu, Tejaswi and Kaushal flare-up severely. Bigg Boss gives a special power to captain Kaushal.

episodes.name: Day 33: The Campaign for Captaincy
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss initiates the new captaincy task where two contenders campaign around the house, hoping to bring a positive change in the contestants. Tune to find out who becomes the next captain.

episodes.name: Day 34: Happy Birthday Ganesh
episodes.overview: Nani confronts the housemates and tries to resolve the issues prevailing in the house. Ganesh is in for a surprise on the occasion of his birthday. Tune in to be a part of this celebration.

episodes.name: Day 35: Nani, the Terminator!
episodes.overview: The contestants play dumb charades with Nani while they stand on an ice base. Nani decides to break the ice and reveal the name of the eliminated contestant. Who will set their foot out of the house?

episodes.name: Day 36: Amit Attacks Ganesh!
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to pair up and tells Geetha to handcuff them. Amit loses his cool and strikes Ganesh's head for nominating him. Ganesh sheds tears and decides to exit the house.

episodes.name: Day 37: The Bigg Boss Bioscope
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss assigns the contestants with a task to shoot a blockbuster movie in the house. The excited thespians exercise their theatricals skills to win an oppurtunity to star in the big budget movie.

episodes.name: Day 38: Lafangirigitta, Coming Soon
episodes.overview: Deepthi Sunaina and Samrat dance their hearts out on an item song. Amit and his team furnish the scenes and finish shooting their blockbuster movie, Lafangirigitta.

episodes.name: Day 39: Pradeep Machiraju in the House
episodes.overview: The housemates are in a good mood as they watch the movie premiere of Lafangirigitta along with special guest, Pradeep Machiraju. Is he the new contender in the Bigg Boss house?

episodes.name: Day 40: La Tomatina in Bigg Boss House
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss initiates the next captaincy task, which involves the contenders juicing tomatoes with their feet. Tune in to see who will crush the most and win the thrilling competition.

episodes.name: Day 41: Nani's Film Review
episodes.overview: Nani discusses the Bigg Boss movie task with the excited housemates and recalls their candid experiences. With five housemates nominated for elimination, who will be saved?

episodes.name: Day 42: Bidding an Emotional Farewell
episodes.overview: Seeing the contestants tense about the elimination, Lakshmi Manchu enters the house to lighten their mood. With Samrat and Tejaswi in the danger zone, tune in to find out who gets eliminated.

guest_stars.name: Lakshmi Manchu

episodes.name: Day 43: Breaking News in Bigg Boss House
episodes.overview: The contestants nominate two housemates and break eggs on their heads before breaking their hearts. A newbie sneaks into the house at midnight and makes herself at home. Who's the dame?

episodes.name: Day 44: Welcome Aboard, Pooja
episodes.overview: New hopes are revived in the house as a wild card contestant, Pooja embarks her journey. Sentiments flare-up as Bigg Boss connects the housemates to their closest family members through the telephone.

episodes.name: Day 45: Pooja, the Wonder Woman
episodes.overview: Pooja actively performs back-breaking tasks to recharge the 'chance to talk' meter. The emotional roller coaster continues as the contestants talk to their loved ones.

episodes.name: Day 46: Panshop Romeos
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss initiates the 'Panshop' task where the housemates try to woo Pooja, the panshop owner. Later, things turns ugly after Geeta shoots sharps accusations at Babu.

episodes.name: Day 47: A Flabbergasted Tanish
episodes.overview: Kaushal, Samrat and Pooja dive into the pool and use their aquatic skills to win the Fogg body spray task. Amidst the tension, an unexpected event relating to Tanish puts a smile on everyone's face.

episodes.name: Day 48: Nani Interrogates the Housemates
episodes.overview: Nani tries to resolve the misunderstandings among the contestants and grills each of the housemates, one by one. At midnight, Tanish ignores the cameras and gets romantic with a housemate.

episodes.name: Day 49: Break the Ice, Burst the Balloons
episodes.overview: Water Balloons fly in all directions in the house while the nominated contestants get soaked. Nani announces the return of two ex-housemate back into the Bigg Boss house. Who are the special two?

episodes.name: Day 50: Childhood Memories in the House
episodes.overview: Bigg Boss strictly warns Kaushal and Deepthi before announcing the nominations. A tide of emotions ripple and resonate in the house as the contestants watch their childhood photos.

episodes.name: Day 51: Pooja's Survival Tactics
episodes.overview: The housemates are impressed as they witness Pooja's exuberant gripping skills while they perform, the Pirates vs Survivors task. Kaushal's notoriety causes problems in the house.

episodes.name: Day 52: Chota Boss and the Accountant
episodes.overview: Roll Rida and Pooja win the pirates task and are made the 'Chota Boss and his accountant' respectively. With the captaincy on the line, Bigg Boss gives one of the bottom three performers a chance to redeem themselves. Who will seize this opportunity?
