episodes.name: Day 66: An Exciting Reunion
episodes.overview: Goutham's mother catches him off guard with her surprise, and Priyanka shares a sweet moment with Shiv. Later, Bhole expresses his love to his wife with a special song.

episodes.name: Day 67: An Emotional Roller Coaster
episodes.overview: Amardeep's joy peaks as he gets a memorable birthday surprise from Tejaswini. Following this, Shobha's mother comes bearing a gift and Prince Yawar reunites with his brother

episodes.name: Day 68: 'Oh Baby' Task
episodes.overview: Prashanth and Rathika spend a joyful time with their families. Later, the housemates must care for crying babies and race to prove their swiftness for the contender status.

episodes.name: Day 69: New Captain, New Games
episodes.overview: Shivaji clinches the captaincy with majority votes, triumphing over Arjun. Later, Nagarjuna asks the housemates to anonymously label each other 'pass' or 'fail' on the board.

episodes.name: Day 70: Diwali Celebrations
episodes.overview: On the occasion of Diwali, join Nagarjuna and the housemates as they engage in an evening of celebration filled with enthralling performances and unlimited fun!

episodes.name: Day 71: Break the Bottle to Nominate
episodes.overview: Ashwini gets emotional thinking about Bhole. It's that time of the week when each one has to nominate two housemates. Who will be in the danger zone?

episodes.name: Day 72: Nominations and Celebrations
episodes.overview: The array of heated arguments continue as rest of the housemates put forth their nominations. The mood lightens when everyone gears up for Deepavali celebrations in the house.

episodes.name: Day 73: Ranking Task
episodes.overview: Housemates engage in serious debates after BB tasks them with a performance- based ranking. However, a twist in the results ignite a tense face-off for the Eviction Pass.

episodes.name: Day 74: The Eviction Pass Relay
episodes.overview: Prince Yawar triumphs over Arjun in the first task and secures his spot in the race. Can he defeat other opponents in diverse challenges and win the coveted Eviction Pass?

episodes.name: Day 75: Welcome, New Captain
episodes.overview: Shobha and Prashanth declare Prince Yawar as the Eviction Pass winner. The following day, housemates engage in two rounds of challenging tasks to select their next captain.

episodes.name: Day 76: Nagarjuna's Reality Check
episodes.overview: King Nagarjuna scrutinizes the housemates' strategies and grills Shivaji for his remarks. He recalls Prince Yawar's performance and questions the fate of his Eviction Pass.

episodes.name: Day 77: Special Guests and Big Surprise
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna welcomes team Kota Bommali and later asks the housemates to tag each other 'add friend' or 'block'. Tension mounts for the eviction, and the King brings in a twist.

episodes.name: Day 78: Nominate by Feeding the Lion
episodes.overview: Shobha becomes the monitor and distributes coffee powder to the housemates. The Nomination process begins, and each one shares their names with reasons. What will be the reactions?

episodes.name: Day 79: A Suspenseful Day in the House
episodes.overview: Housemates engage in a series of discussions about nominations, and lock horns to win the Eviction Pass. Unaware of the impending mystery, the housemates savour BB's lunch party.

episodes.name: Day 80: A Killer on the Loose!
episodes.overview: Inspectors Amardeep and Arjun begin their investigation in the BB mansion. As the murderer goes on a killing spree, how will this case get solved?

episodes.name: Day 81: Under Arrest
episodes.overview: Manager Shivaji executes his secret tasks and hands over the baton to Priyanka. On the other hand, the investigators arrest Rathika for the murder. Is she indeed the real suspect?

episodes.name: Day 82: Shoot to Choose
episodes.overview: For this week's captaincy, the housemates have to eliminate the contenders with gunshots. The one who is shot loses the game. Who will go forward in this race?

episodes.name: Day 83: The King's Wise Advice
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna confronts Prashanth, Ashwini, Amardeep and Shivaji for their actions in the previous week. Later he guides and warns the housemates about their gameplay.

episodes.name: Day 84: Quizzes and Farewell Drama
episodes.overview: Ashwini joins Nagarjuna on stage and later, he hosts quizzes igniting enthusiasm among the housemates. However, tension arises as one gets ready to bid farewell.

episodes.name: Day 85: Housemates' Hues
episodes.overview: Housemates clash in a 'hellish' nomination face-off, throwing paint and accusations against each other. In the process, alliances crumble, sparking intense drama in the house.

episodes.name: Day 86: A Fight for the Finale Astra
episodes.overview: The Ticket to Finale race kicks off, and each task becomes a battleground for points. Only the housemates with highest points advance in this cutthroat contest. Who will endure?

episodes.name: Day 87: Priyanka Scores The Least
episodes.overview: The housemates face two more challenges to earn points for the 'Ticket to Finale'. Priyanka stands low on the score and picks Goutham to share her points, which upsets Amardeep.

episodes.name: Day 88: The Race Resumes
episodes.overview: In the Ticket to Finale series, Yawar scores the lowest today and decides to give away his points to Prashanth. With only four left in the race, who will win the finale astra?

episodes.name: Day 89: Meet the First Finalist
episodes.overview: Goutham's move reshapes the game, setting Prashanth, Amardeep, and Arjun against each other in an intense showdown. Who will rise above the others and become the first finalist?

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Bigg Boss 7 is the seventh season of the Telugu version of the Indian reality television series Bigg Boss based on the Dutch series Big Brother.

episodes.name: Season Premiere
episodes.overview: Get ready as King Nagarjuna returns in a grand style to unveil the contestants of an electrifying new season, packed with limitless drama and entertainment

episodes.name: Day 1: A Task for the Third Chief
episodes.overview: An array of arguments ensues as the contestants enter the house. Later, the housemates' physical strength is put to test to grab the spot of the third chief.

episodes.name: Day 2: Nomination Sparks Fiery Fights
episodes.overview: After a midnight altercation, the house meets in the morning to discuss tasks. Later, housemates clash with the chiefs during the season's first nomination.

episodes.name: Day 3: Confession Room's First Visitor
episodes.overview: Tension rises as the housemates engage in verbal war to nominate each other. Subsequently, BB summons Manikanta to the confession room.

episodes.name: Day 4: Chiefs to Select Their Clan
episodes.overview: Stronger the clan, powerful the chief! The three chiefs must choose a team for themselves, not only by convincing the housemates but also by performing a task.

episodes.name: Day 5: Clash of Clans
episodes.overview: Yashmi and Nainika’s clans battle through tasks for the opportunity to steal a member from Nikhil’s team. However, a surprise from BB leaves the winners in awe.

episodes.name: Day 6: King Meets the Housemates
episodes.overview: Excitement fills the air as Nagarjuna joins the housemates for Vinayaka Chavithi. Later, things become intense when he dives into individual performance reviews.

episodes.name: Day 7: First Eviction
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna amps up the fun with new games and a paycheck twist. Later, the atmosphere sours when the housemates bid farewell to the first evictee.

episodes.name: Day 8: A Colourful Nomination
episodes.overview: It is that time of the week when the housemates have to take names for eviction. A verbal war begins as they pour the paint on the ones they nominate.

episodes.name: Day 9: Food Lockdown?
episodes.overview: Nomination spirals into personal attacks and painful disputes, leaving Nainika in tears. The drama intensifies as BB orders housemates to surrender all their ration.

episodes.name: Day 10: Find and Run
episodes.overview: The chiefs get a chance to shop for groceries, while their clans fight to defend the respective provisions. During the task, Sanchalak Yashmi faces pushback over her strict rules.

episodes.name: Day 11: A Battle for the Budget
episodes.overview: BB provides a bunch of opportunities for the housemates to win their budget. Each of the clans puts up a tough fight, but the Sanchalak's decision leads to chaos.

episodes.name: Day 12: Special Gifts for the Housemates
episodes.overview: After Prerana’s decision on the Socks task, the house engages in an energetic Truth or Dare game. The lively mood shifts to an emotional tone with an unexpected surprise from BB.

episodes.name: Day 13: Shocks and A Surprise
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna assesses the chiefs and clans with a mix of praise and critique. Further, he brightens Shekar’s day with good news while delivering a shocker to the chiefs.

episodes.name: Day 14: Elect Chiefs, Evict a Member
episodes.overview: Sunday Funday begins with electing new chiefs and members, followed by Nagarjuna’s energetic games. The drama heightens as he drops a new twist in this week's eviction.

episodes.name: Day 15: Dusty Nominations and Drama
episodes.overview: Clans Kantara and Shakti delegate tasks and discuss last week's robbery. Yet another series of verbal war ensues as the nominations with dust showers begin.

episodes.name: Day 16: Clans Kantara vs Shakti
episodes.overview: After going over the nominations, housemates challenge each other for this week’s provisions. Which clan will grab the most points from the three intense tasks?

episodes.name: Day 17: Prabhavathi Is Back!
episodes.overview: Disputes arise over Sonia's decision on the balloon task. The next day, the chiefs tackle a new task while Prabhavathi 2.0 returns to the house to present a special assignment.

episodes.name: Day 18: Procure Eggs to Prevail
episodes.overview: The housemates compete fiercely to collect the maximum eggs. As the clans face a cooking restriction, the losing team is forced to eliminate one member.

episodes.name: Day 19: Who Will be the Next Chief?
episodes.overview: With the red egg, clan Shakti wins the advantage to choose one member for chief contendership. On the other hand, BB shows the main door to clan Kantara for disobeying the rules.

episodes.name: Day 20: Season's First Red Card
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna confronts the housemates about their misbehaviour. He calls out everyone's faults and, in a dramatic twist, shows a red card to Abhai for his reckless comments.

episodes.name: Day 21: Playtime with the King
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna ignites a wave of laughter this weekend with quirky games that keep the housemates on edge. As the thrill escalates, one contestant gets ready to exit.

episodes.name: Day 22: Nomination in Full Swing!
episodes.overview: As housemates reminisce about their time with the evictee, they gear up for this week’s nominations. With emotions flaring over past disputes, how will the process play out?

episodes.name: Day 23: Welcome, New Chief
episodes.overview: With emotions still high from the nominations, Yashmi and Sonia get into a brawl. Later, Nikhil competes with the housemates for a chance to choose clan Kantara's next chief.

episodes.name: Day 24: A Bigg Twist
episodes.overview: Seetha takes charge of her new Kantara clan. Soon after, the house descends into chaos when BB reveals the potential arrival of 12 wildcards. What challenges await the housemates?

episodes.name: Day 25: Clan Shakti in Turmoil
episodes.overview: Shakti clan wins the thrilling third task of 'Survival of the Fittest', and gains the power to eliminate a Kantara member. Manikanta revolts, sparking arguments within his clan.

episodes.name: Day 26: Imitation Game
episodes.overview: BB shares the perks of a golden band, which a member of the Shakti clan puts to work. Later, laughter echoes through the house as everyone engages in mimicry for the next task.

episodes.name: Day 27: A Crowning Ceremony
episodes.overview: Past conflicts resurface when Nagarjuna asks the housemates to classify each other as 'heroes' and 'zeroes.' One faces the danger zone, while another is saved from eviction.

episodes.name: Day 28: Housemates Take a Call
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna hosts an exciting day filled with engaging games that keep the housemates fully entertained. However, he shocks them by granting the power to save or evict a nominee.

episodes.name: Day 29: Nominations of Fire
episodes.overview: The housemates present their nominations by throwing the pictures on fire, sparking arguments. Simultaneously, they are asked to vote out one of the chiefs. Who will that be?

episodes.name: Day 30: Clan Shakti's Winning Streak
episodes.overview: Survival of the Fittest series continues, and both the clans put up a tough fight in the challenges. As clan Shakti outperforms, clan Kantara is compelled to remove two members.

episodes.name: Day 31: Pick Your Next Chief
episodes.overview: Clan Shakti secures victory and selects a chief contender to block the wildcards. Emotional disputes surface when BB allows others to compete for the position.

episodes.name: Day 32: Midweek Eviction
episodes.overview: BB dissolves the clans and hosts a task for the contenders to become Mega Chief. As one of them takes charge, an unexpected midweek eviction leaves everyone shell-shocked.

episodes.name: Day 33: A Token of Love
episodes.overview: Manikanta’s amusing predictions as an astrologer earn applause in the house. A cloud of tension looms later when they face tough choices and special gifts in the confession room.

episodes.name: Day 34: A Reality Check
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna highlights this week’s events and some shortcomings of the housemates. While Aditya bids farewell, the house anticipates arrival of the wildcards.

episodes.name: Day 35: The Grand Reload Event
episodes.overview: One more housemate bids goodbye. Tables turn as the King welcomes the wildcard entrants and splits all the housemates into two new clans. What surprises are about to be unveiled?

episodes.name: Day 36: New Housemates, New Drama
episodes.overview: A wave of excitement fills the house as OG clan welcomes the wildcards aka the Royal clan. However, their happiness is short-lived as nominations from the newbies stun everyone.

episodes.name: Day 37: Mega Chief's Plea to BB
episodes.overview: Royal Clan reaps benefits during nominations, putting others in a tough spot. Chaos ensues in the house after mega chief Nabeel slips up during his trip to the supermarket.

episodes.name: Day 38: Welcome to BB Hotel
episodes.overview: Avinash takes charge of the ladies, while Rohini coaches the boys in a hilarious challenge. Later, the OG clan excitedly rolls out the red carpet for the Royals to their new Hotel.

episodes.name: Day 39: Staff vs the Guests
episodes.overview: Staff swap roles and impress the guests for rewards, but a new physical challenge complicates matters. As time runs out and prize money increases, which clan will claim victory?

episodes.name: Day 40: Royals Fight for Leadership
episodes.overview: Six members of Royal clan face off against one member from OG to become the next Mega Chief. However, the tasks go awry as contenders engage in personal conflicts.

episodes.name: Day 41: A Spotlight on Royal Clan
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna confronts the BB Hotel drama while handing out penalties and advice. As the royals’ gameplay faces intense scrutiny, the stakes for eviction predictions rise.

episodes.name: Day 42: Dusshera Subhakankshalu
episodes.overview: King commences the festivities with special games, guests and stunning performances. Amidst this, one housemate is granted a special wish, while another packs their bag to leave.

episodes.name: Day 43: Killer Girls Get to Choose
episodes.overview: Amidst the daily tiffs, BB kicks off the nominations for this week. Killer girls Hari Teja and Prerana get to approve the housemates' choices, ensuing intense confrontations.

episodes.name: Day 44: The Game-Changer
episodes.overview: Nominations go astray when housemates and nominees engage in hateful verbal wars. Adding to the chaos, BB grants the Royal clan a special power which flips the game.

episodes.name: Day 45: Brawls Over Battery
episodes.overview: Nabeel's selfless wish and a hilarious skit brings rewards to the kitchen. Gangavva becomes a contender, while the rest fight for a chance through the Battery task.

episodes.name: Day 46: High Voltage Drama
episodes.overview: Royals take out one opponent and desperately try to gain battery in exchange for facilities. Although the OGs resist the temptation, an internal argument throws them into panic.

episodes.name: Day 47: Final Fight for Mega Chief
episodes.overview: Royal clan wins the pillow challenge. Avinash and Prithvi get the opportunity to earn additional prize money but at a cost. Finally, who will take over as the Mega Chief?

episodes.name: Day 48: Its Time for 'BB Times'
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna talks about the past week's happenings and later initiates an intriguing BB Times task. Meanwhile, Prithvi gets an exclusive yet challenging offer. Will he accept it?

episodes.name: Day 49: Games Galore
episodes.overview: The atmosphere buzzes with excitement as Nagarjuna entertains the housemates with interesting games. As the fun unfolds, one housemate gets ready to exit the house.

episodes.name: Day 50: Midway through the Race
episodes.overview: During the pot-breaking nomination process, tensions flare between Prithvi and Rohini. Later, mega chief Gowtham uses a shield to protect a housemate, leaving Prerana disappointed.

episodes.name: Day 51: Pot-breaking Nominations
episodes.overview: Prithvi and Vishnupriya top the list of nominations. Concerned, the OGs urge Prithvi to reconsider his gameplay, while mega chief Gowtham gets the privilege to save a nominee.

episodes.name: Day 52: Royals' Shenanigans
episodes.overview: A spontaneous gym session and a spooky prank by the Royals lift everyone's spirits. The next day, housemates gear up to decide who’s in the running to become the mega chief.

episodes.name: Day 53: OG Clan Turns the Table
episodes.overview: OG clan wins over the Royals and choose Prithvi and Nikhil as contenders for the Chief. OGs also claim that the title winner of S8 will be one among them.

episodes.name: Day 54: Meet Your New Mega Chief
episodes.overview: As BB introduces tougher tasks with clever twists, more contenders enter the race and disagreements arise within the clans. Who will be declared as next week's mega chief?

episodes.name: Day 55: Funday with Suriya
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna commends Gangavva for her prank and addresses last week’s conflicts with the housemates. Later, the excitement peaks when actor Suriya join him for a lively evening.

episodes.name: Day 56: Diwali Dhamaka
episodes.overview: The festivities begin with heartwarming surprises and fun games for the housemates. To add to the excitement, Nagarjuna invites celebrities on stage before eviction.

episodes.name: Day 57: It's Jail Time for Nominees
episodes.overview: Avinash's sudden exit shocks all, while BB's decision to let mega chief Vishnupriya imprison five nominees heightens the drama. Hurt by her picks, OGs seek redemption in round two.

episodes.name: Day 58: The Mega Clan
episodes.overview: The OG and Royal clans merge and together compete for the Mega Chief contendership. Four teams of three battle to secure at least one top position, leading to chaos.

episodes.name: Day 59: Team Yellow Lags Behind
episodes.overview: The water tank task continues and so do the intense fights. Team Green wins and gets to roll the dice, while teams Blue and Red manage to win the next two tasks.

episodes.name: Day 60: Emotional Outbursts
episodes.overview: To earn extra cooking time, Rohini and Avinash get a task of turning into toddlers. As the challenges for the Mega Chief gets tougher, who will finally win the title this week?

episodes.name: Day 61: Happy Diwali!
episodes.overview: Festive excitement fills the air as housemates enjoy Diwali with a special pooja and lively competitions. Mega chief Avinash makes a request, while BB surprises them all.

episodes.name: Day 62: Nagarjuna’s Message to the House
episodes.overview: King applauds Avinash for his fun penalties directed at the midday sleepyheads. He also praises the teams for their task performance while reinforcing the importance of decorum.

episodes.name: Day 63: Non-Stop Fun with the King
episodes.overview: The evening turns exhilarating as Nagarjuna engages housemates with quirky guessing games. Later, he hosts a juice mixing challenge ahead of the eviction.

episodes.name: Day 64: Nomination Frenzy
episodes.overview: The week kicks off with heightened emotions as housemates face nominations. Past conflicts resurface, and mega chief Avinash steps in to save a nominee.

episodes.name: Day 65: Contendership Up For Grabs
episodes.overview: Nabeel, Prithvi and Rohini unexpectedly win the contendership for Mega Chief. Their next challenge is to retain this victory by battling the tough tasks designed for them.

episodes.name: Day 66: Spill the Tea
episodes.overview: Contenders Vishnupriya, Prerana and Yashmi confront each other in a strenuous task to grab the spot. Later, BB gives an interesting dare to Prerana and Tasty Teja.

episodes.name: Day 67: Chaos Over Contendership
episodes.overview: A prank leaves chief contender Yashmi on edge, while Prithvi's actions make Vishnupriya question their bond. In the final round, housemates jeopardise Nabeel's chance to win.

episodes.name: Day 68: Eviction Shield
episodes.overview: Prerana is crowned as the new mega chief, leaving Rohini upset. Later, BB gives housemates a chance to earn an eviction shield by nominating those they deem unworthy.

episodes.name: Day 69: Nagarjuna's Verdict
episodes.overview: Rule violation and poor performance land Tasty Teja in trouble, while Nagarjuna gives the contenders a chance to win the shield. Unfortunate results await one of the housemates.

episodes.name: Day 70: Cosplay Fun and Food Theft
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna looks into the food theft, while the housemates entertain him with a playful cosplay game. Later, Varun Tej joins them ahead of this week's elimination.

episodes.name: Day 71: Nomination Fall Out
episodes.overview: Reeling from last week's drama, housemates face nominations where they paint criticisms on each other's portraits. Tasty Teja and Gowtham get defensive, which sparks heated tiffs.

episodes.name: Day 72: Family Week
episodes.overview: The most awaited days are finally here! Nabeel and Rohini welcome their dear ones to the house. On the other hand, Tasty Teja makes a tearful plea to BB.

episodes.name: Day 73: A Sweet Surprise for Avinash
episodes.overview: Yashmi and Nikhil's happiness knows no bounds as their parents enter the house and join them in various tasks. Avinash reunites with his wife, but faces a very crucial choice.

episodes.name: Day 74: Happy Reunions
episodes.overview: Excitement fills the air when Vishnupriya and Prithvi reunite with their loved ones. Adding to it, Gowtham's brother visits him, while Prerana receives a sweet virtual surprise.

episodes.name: Day 75: Unexpected Arrivals, Unlimited Joy
episodes.overview: Family week ends on a high note as Prerana and Tasty Teja receive heartwarming surprises. Later, the housemates gear up to choose their next mega chief.

episodes.name: Day 76: Limitless Fun with the Guests
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna interacts with the housemates and recalls their memorable moments from the week. Later, he welcomes celebrities and family members to join him on stage.

episodes.name: Day 77: A Game-Changing Choice
episodes.overview: Housemates' loved ones continue to visit, and Nagarjuna keeps them engaged with games. Tension builds as Nabeel faces the crucial decision of whether to use his eviction shield.

episodes.name: Day 78: Evictees' Comeback!
episodes.overview: As part of a nomination twist, Sonia, Shekar, and Bebakka enter to the house to nominate two housemates. During the defense, tempers flare and clashes erupt between them.

episodes.name: Day 79: Housemates in a Fix
episodes.overview: Nominations by Aditya, Nainika, Manikanta and Seetha bring hidden issues to light, leaving the housemates bitter and upset. Will these issues tear apart their bonds?

episodes.name: Day 80: One Last Battle to Become Contender
episodes.overview: Housemates reflect on the nominations, after which a prank leaves Tasty Teja clueless. Later, chaos ensues as they battle to protect their t-shirts to secure a spot as a contender.

episodes.name: Day 81: Vishwak Sen Visits the House
episodes.overview: Nikhil and Rohini compete for a spot, but Gowtham's accusation against the OG clan sparks arguments. After the contenders face a gruelling task, Vishwak Sen makes a surprise entry.

episodes.name: Day 82: Season's Last Mega Chief
episodes.overview: The contenders face intense tasks to become the season's final Mega Chief. Amidst this, an argument between Rohini and Vishnupriya adds to the drama. Who will claim the title?

episodes.name: Day 83: A Stern Warning from the King
episodes.overview: Rohini and Vishnupriya are reprimanded for their actions, while Gowtham and Prithvi receive a warning. Later, a game of Snakes and Ladders leaves Nikhil and Gowtham with a twist.

episodes.name: Day 84: Eviction Day
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna enjoys the housemates' fun guessing game and their witty complaints. However, all eyes soon shift to Yashmi and Prithvi, who anxiously await their fate.

episodes.name: Day 85: Paint it Red!
episodes.overview: BB asks the housemates to nominate those who don't deserve to be in the grand finale. As each one steps forward for the activity, heated arguments take over the house.

episodes.name: Day 86: The TTF Race Begins
episodes.overview: Former contestants Akhil and Harika kickstart the Ticket to Finale battle. They must choose the contenders for the first task and present a black badge to the loser.

episodes.name: Day 87: Strength, Strategy Put to Test
episodes.overview: Priyanka and Manas enter the house to plan round two and finalise yet another contender for the TTF race. Who will grab the next spot, and who will get the black star?

episodes.name: Day 88: May the Strongest One Win
episodes.overview: The hunt to pick the next contender resumes when Punarnavi and Vithika enter. Nikhil takes the lead, while some housemates raise voices against the unjust decisions.

episodes.name: Day 89: Ticket To Finale Goes to...
episodes.overview: Nikhil, Rohini, and Avinash pick Teja as the fourth contender. Later, Sreemukhi enters the house to unfold a few twists. Finally, who will win the Ticket to Finale?

episodes.name: Day 90: Double Eviction
episodes.overview: Avinash makes it to the finals, but Nagarjuna’s Ticket game sparks tension. In addition, a shocking double eviction twist leaves the housemates on edge.

episodes.name: Day 91: One Left, Who's Next?
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna brings in a set of hilarious and entertaining games for the housemates. Tension rises for yet another eviction of this week. Who will bid goodbye?

episodes.name: Day 92: A Battle for the Second Spot
episodes.overview: Nominations leave everyone at risk except Avinash. Nikhil and Gowtham lock horns during the task, while Nabeel and Prerana get a golden opportunity, but it comes at a price.

episodes.name: Day 93: Vote Appeal
episodes.overview: Housemates get one chance to appeal for votes, leading to a heated argument between Nabeel and Rohini. Shekhar Master's surprise visit brings added excitement with a fun twist.

episodes.name: Day 94: Task Decision Sparks Unrest
episodes.overview: Chaos erupts as Prerana contests Nabeel's win for a chance to appeal for votes. Later, the Vah-Chef makes a surprise entry into the house and prepares a delicious feast.

episodes.name: Day 95: Who Will Secure the Next Spot?
episodes.overview: Avinash's sacrifice helps Rohini take the lead, while Vishnupriya wins the second round. Now, it's up to the rest of the housemates to pick one of them. Who will that be?

episodes.name: Day 96: Verbal War
episodes.overview: Nikhil and Gowtham face off for a chance to appeal, but the former's sharp remarks lead to a major clash. Later, Ohmkar makes a surprise visit to the house.

episodes.name: Day 97: Eviction Shocker
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna delves into the housemates' regrets from their journey so far. He then shocks everyone with a Double Elimination announcement, leaving the housemates on edge.

episodes.name: Day 98: Meet the Finalists
episodes.overview: Housemates discuss their plans for the prize money. After exciting tasks and reveals, Nagarjuna announces the finalists, while the remaining one faces eviction.

episodes.name: Day 99: Maa vs BB Parivaaram
episodes.overview: To increase the prize money, the finalists take on quirky tasks. The excitement doubles as Maa stars joins them, bringing chaos, laughter and nonstop entertainment to the house.

episodes.name: Day 100: Bigg Wins
episodes.overview: Kavya, Ganga and Gangadhar from Maa Parivaar light up the house with their fun-filled entry. Later, they take on thrilling challenges with the finalists to boost the prize money.

episodes.name: Day 101: A Fun Banter with BB
episodes.overview: The housemates prepare some tasty treats for Bigg Boss, and BB returns the favour with delicious delights. Later, Maa Parivaram stars Vaishanavi and Krishna enter the house.

episodes.name: Day 102: A Trip Down the Memory Lane
episodes.overview: With just a few days left for the finale, BB prepares some special treats for the finalists. Today, Gautham and Avinash get a chance to relive their incredible journey in S8.

episodes.name: Day 103: Reliving the Season
episodes.overview: Nikhil, Nabeel and Prerna get to go through and celebrate their amazing journeys of this season. BB motivates them and wishes goodluck for the finale.

episodes.name: Day 104: And the Countdown Begins!
episodes.overview: With just one day for the grand finale, the housemates share the best and worst memories of their life with BB. Later, ever gracious Suma enters to entertain the finalists.

episodes.name: Day 105: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: After 14 weeks of limitless drama and entertainment, Nagarjuna sets the stage for the epic finale. Who will seize the dream trophy and become the winner?

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: Bigg Boss 8 is the eigth season of the Telugu version of the Indian reality television series Bigg Boss based on the Dutch series Big Brother.

episodes.name: Season Premiere
episodes.overview: The wait is over! King Nagarjuna returns with a dazzling new season full of glamour, thrills and the twist of double house, double dose! What shocks await the contestants?

episodes.name: Day 1: Drama Over Duty
episodes.overview: On the very first day, owners and tenants lock horns over chore duties. Heated food fights, restrictions, and harsh remarks leave the house divided.

episodes.name: Day 2: First Nomination Sparks Chaos
episodes.overview: Tempers soar as fights break out during the first nomination process. An unexpected accident shakes the house, turning even the kitchen into a war zone.

episodes.name: Day 3: Special Power and Scuffles
episodes.overview: Arguments continue to break out as Srija confronts Sanjana and Thanuja. Harish’s anger brings tears, while Priya and Bharani ignite fierce disputes with rivals.

episodes.name: Day 4: Battle for Captaincy Begins
episodes.overview: Captaincy task ignites drama as Manish and Emmanuel clash over fairness. Sanjana’s ban stirs tension, while Rithu and Pavan indulge in cute banter.

episodes.name: Day 5: Sanjana’s Rule Under Fire
episodes.overview: Captain Sanjana’s strict reign descends into chaos, earning her the nickname ‘Hitler.’ Tensions flare between Emmanuel and Harish, while Manish backfires during thumbs-up challenge

episodes.name: Day 6: Weekly Recap with the King
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna settles house fights, questions Sanjana and resolves the theft drama. He wraps up the first weekly recap by smashing the boxes.

episodes.name: Day 7: First Eviction
episodes.overview: Owners come under fire for partiality, and the captain learns the extent of her powers. Nagarjuna welcomes Team Mirai on stage just before announcing the first eviction.

episodes.name: Day 8: Paint to Nominate
episodes.overview: This week's nominations turns personal, creating a divide in the house. Harish refuses to eat, while Manish calls out two-faced behaviour.

episodes.name: Day 9: Fiery Verbal Tiffs
episodes.overview: Priya takes aim at Bharani’s cooking, while Harish picks a fight with Emmanuel. Moreover, Rithu and Ramu push the tension higher during nominations. Who’s in trouble this week?

episodes.name: Day 10: A Night of No Surrender
episodes.overview: Housemates burst into laughter with Emmanuel and Thanuja’s romcom skit and Rithu’s cheeky plea. Later, the mood flips when they face a captaincy task that tests their endurance.

episodes.name: Day 11: The Paint Battle
episodes.overview: Tenants dismiss Priya due to her mood swings, and other owners which sparks fights over favoritism. Subsequently, the Rangu Padudundi task ignites an array of arguments.

episodes.name: Day 12: Fair Play or Favouritism?
episodes.overview: The fight to win yet another permanent membership in the BB house turns physical with Suman’s outburst. Later, Rithu’s emotional gameplay ignites clashes with Emmanuel and Thanuja.

episodes.name: Day 13: Nagarjuna Grills the Owners
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna revokes captaincy, forcing contenders to redo tasks with swapped roles. A heartfelt video call moves the house, while praise and scoldings stir tension.

episodes.name: Day 14: Sunday Fun Turns Tense
episodes.overview: The king kicks off the day with laughter as he teases Thanuja’s secret crush and leads a fun lyrics game. The mood shifts with a tough captaincy task and tense votes.

episodes.name: Day 15: Swap a Nominee!
episodes.overview: Drama ignites in the third nominations as rivalries erupt and alliances crack among the new tenants. A shocking twist leaves the house questioning everyone’s game.

episodes.name: Day 16: Tears and Tough Choices
episodes.overview: Rithu and Srija feel disheartened by the lack of support. Later, BB brings in letters from home with a catch, and Emmanuel earns the chance to make the first tough choice.

episodes.name: Day 17: Battery Low, Drama High
episodes.overview: Thanuja faces a dilemma to risk the final 10% battery to open her gifts. Later, the Immunity task spirals out of control with a shocking clash.

episodes.name: Day 18: Agnipariksha Warriors Assemble!
episodes.overview: Thanuja lashes out at Ram, sparking clashes with Sanjana and Emmanuel. Housemates debate fiercely after 4 Agnipariksha contestants enter the house with a twist.

episodes.name: Day 19: Midnight Eviction Shakes the House
episodes.overview: Divya’s bold rankings stir tension among the housemates. A midnight alarm grants the red seed housemates a powerful decision, leaving everyone on edge and awaiting the fallout.

episodes.name: Day 20: A Second Chance
episodes.overview: Scoldings fly and secrets spill as Nagarjuna reviews this week’s drama. Sanjana gets a chance to return, but could a choice shut the door on her forever?

episodes.name: Day 21: Dasara Dhamaka in the House
episodes.overview: The house turns festive with guests joining Nagarjuna, star performances and Bathukamma celebrations. However, drama unfolds as emotions flare and one contestant faces elimination.

episodes.name: Day 22: Reach for the Immunity Stars
episodes.overview: Thanuja and Sanjana’s fight over food sparks drama in the house. The Immunity task begins, giving nominees a chance to avoid eviction. Will they make it count?

episodes.name: Day 23: Roll a Dice
episodes.overview: Captain Pavan leads the task with his special power. Winning teams take turns nominating rivals, leading to noisy fights, and Divya boldly stands her ground in defense.

episodes.name: Day 24: Clash of the Contenders
episodes.overview: Housemates hustle in tasks for perks and Powercards. Kalyan clashes with Thanuja, and later faces Harish in a one-on-one showdown.

episodes.name: Day 25: Tensions Explode for Power Cards
episodes.overview: The game heats up as Suman and Thanuja are disqualified, sparking a series of arguments. Additionally, a joke from Emmanuel causes drama, leaving Thanuja in tears.

episodes.name: Day 26: A Chaotic Captaincy Task
episodes.overview: Four contenders face housemates’ verdict in a rain dance task, with one eliminated each round. Rithu’s decision upsets Kalyan, while sparks fly in a clash with Srija.

episodes.name: Day 27: Nagarjuna Calls Out House Drama
episodes.overview: King Nagarjuna’s explosive weekend shakes the house to its core! The Black Star twist puts Harish and Flora under fire over unity, value, and sportsmanship.

episodes.name: Day 28: Game Time with the King
episodes.overview: Laughter echoes through the BB house as Nagarjuna brings fun games. Rithu and Srija’s hilarious skit wins hearts, but emotions run high during the eviction.

episodes.name: Day 29: Gaali Nippu Neeru Challenge
episodes.overview: Fun turns into frustration as housemates vie for immunity this week, with Bharani leaving some in tears. Star Strategies win the task, but who among them will get immunity?

episodes.name: Day 30: Half Scores, Full Drama!
episodes.overview: BB’s shocking announcement about the wildcards’ entry shakes the housemates. Bharani and Emmanuel clash during a tough task, while Sanjana breaks down emotionally.

episodes.name: Day 31: Drama Peaks After Task Meltdown
episodes.overview: The house explodes as the Balance Weight Task sparks chaos and Sanjana protests in tears. However, laughter returns with the fun 'Match It, Win It' challenge!

episodes.name: Day 32: Emotions on Edge
episodes.overview: The challenge to escape the Danger Zone heats up with fiery clashes and competition. One duo gets the boot, while Rithu seals a big win.

episodes.name: Day 33: Blindfold Chaos and Broken Trust
episodes.overview: Fights and a blame game erupt between pairs during the Firestorm task. A blindfolded battle for captaincy builds suspense, and Divya is left hurt by Thanuja’s broken promise.

episodes.name: Day 34: Enter the Powerastra
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna interrogates Bharani and Thanuja. Divya’s words add fuel, Rithu and Pavan face heat, while the Powerastra twist unleashes a fierce contest.

episodes.name: Day 35: King Unleashes the Firestorm
episodes.overview: A double eviction stuns the house, but the real twist? Wildcard entries. Nagarjuna and Team 'Dude' bring laughter and chaos to an unforgettable night.

episodes.name: Day 36: Firestorms' First Day
episodes.overview: Madhuri breaks down following a heated spat with Kalyan and Divya about cooking. In the Ball of Fire nominations, the housemates' choices ignite rivalries.

episodes.name: Day 37: Battle of Powers
episodes.overview: The BB house erupts as fiery nominations target Bharani, Thanuja and more. Accusations fly, betrayal brews and housemates unleash powers in a storm of shifting loyalties.

episodes.name: Day 38: Smiles to Storms
episodes.overview: Emmanuel’s lip-syncs and Ramya’s food party lift the house’s spirits. The joy is short-lived as Madhuri argues with housemates and Divya clashes with Thanuja.

episodes.name: Day 39: An Emotional Rollercoaster
episodes.overview: A clash over unfair play rattles the house and shakes alliances. Later, Ayesha and Emmanuel’s acts lift the mood, ending the day with laughter, surprises and a grand feast.

episodes.name: Day 40: Double Captaincy Task
episodes.overview: Challenges push housemates to their limits in the double captaincy task. Nikhil uses his special power to face Gaurav while tempers flare in the kitchen.

episodes.name: Day 41: Bias and Bigg Questions
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna questions the wildcards' powers. Tensions rise as Divya, Madhuri and others face heat over favoritism, clashes and house dynamics.

episodes.name: Day 42: Festive Vibes and A Shocking Exit
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna’s wit sparks fun during Bigg Boss’s grand Diwali bash. Warm calls and Sudheer Babu’s team entertain, but a surprise eviction shakes the festive mood.

episodes.name: Day 43: Balloon Task Blasts Open Rivalries
episodes.overview: Chaos unfolds on BB nomination night as Emmanuel and Ayesha’s balloon task shifts power. Fierce clashes between Divya, Ramu and Thanuja heat the house.

episodes.name: Day 44: Wanted Peta
episodes.overview: The house witnesses a bitter clash between Thanuja and Emmanuel. The mood then shifts from intense drama to wild laughter with the Wanted Peta and Goli Soda tasks.

episodes.name: Day 45: Gang Leaders Swap Sides for Food!
episodes.overview: Chaos and laughter erupt as gang leaders abandon their food stalls to eat from rivals! Emmanuel switches sides, and a Velcro slipper task sparks nonstop giggles!

episodes.name: Day 46: Cops Take over the House
episodes.overview: Emmanuel’s task leaves everyone in stitches, but the muddy flag battle quickly shifts the vibe. Subsequently, cops Ambati Arjun and Amardeep crash in, causing funny mayhem!

episodes.name: Day 47: Who Will Win the Crown of Power?
episodes.overview: Sanjana Silencer and Mass Madhuri get interrogated by the cops, sparking chaos. As the captaincy task heats up, Thanuja, Rithu and Emmanuel fight fiercely to survive.

episodes.name: Day 48: Mid-Season Mayhem
episodes.overview: Nearly fifty days in, alliances are questioned and tempers rise. Nagarjuna grills the housemates, addressing conflicts, nominations and harsh remarks.

episodes.name: Day 49: Buzzer Battles and Fun Games
episodes.overview: Rithu, Thanuja, Pavan and Suman compete for the Golden Buzzer. Emmanuel gives Sanjana an invisible cape and Nagarjuna hosts Sunday games ahead of the eviction.

episodes.name: Day 50: Return of the Forsaken
episodes.overview: Panic grips the house as evictees return to nominate. Flora accuses Rithu of a fake love story, but the main clash erupts when Srija's power-play pits Madhuri against Rithu.

episodes.name: Day 51: Re-Entry Reckoning
episodes.overview: Evictees Bharani and Srija return with nominating powers, sparking chaos. Sanjana clashes with Bharani, and Madhuri's warning to Srija ignites a fiery confrontation.

episodes.name: Day 52: Allies or Enemies?
episodes.overview: Housemates take sides as BB announces permit for only one re-entered contestant to stay. Suman’s wit keeps everyone entertained, but a shocking clash takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.name: Day 53: Food Wars and a Battle for Power
episodes.overview: The house is on edge as food sparks clashes, and Thanuja locks horns with Madhuri. Bharani and Srija’s teams face off, and her demand for importance further fuels the drama.

episodes.name: Day 54: Tea Trouble and Tense Twists
episodes.overview: A massive fight over tea erupts between Kalyan, Thanuja, Rithu, and Divya. Later, Madhuri's dozing and Emmanuel's banter lighten the mood, but the night ends with a shocking twist.

episodes.name: Day 55: Tensions Rise, Nagarjuna Steps In
episodes.overview: Housemates clash with Sanjana for calling Suman an incapable captain. Tensions rise further when Pavan manhandles Rithu, prompting Nagarjuna to step in with a stern warning.

episodes.name: Day 56: Golden Buzzer Showdown
episodes.overview: Rashmika and Deekshith join the house, bringing humour and excitement. Tensions rise over ration issues, and Thanuja faces a choice with her golden buzzer as eviction approaches.

episodes.name: Day 57: Stand Up or Step Out
episodes.overview: Drama unfolds as housemates scramble for Teddy Bears to save their favourites. Kalyan loses his temper over Ramu’s decision, while Captain Divya makes a direct nomination.

episodes.name: Day 58: Double Agents on a Mission
episodes.overview: BB amps up the captaincy challenge by assigning secret missions through phone calls. Gaurav’s warning fades into the chaos, while two rebels plot their next explosive move.

episodes.name: Day 59: Ghosts, Giggles and Missing Milk
episodes.overview: A spooky task leaves the housemates screaming and laughing. Chaos erupts over missing milk as Gaurav blames Rithu, all while Suman secretly enjoys it.

episodes.name: Day 60: Rebel's Hidden Game
episodes.overview: BB gives Rithu a secret task to stir trouble, while housemates suspect Emmanuel to be a rebel. Raise the Flag task begins, and a fierce fight erupts over captaincy.

episodes.name: Day 61: Emotions Run Off Course
episodes.overview: Housemates oust each other in the Train task, and Thanuja breaks down after an unfair exit. Nikhil’s move fuels tension, while two contenders fight to become the next captain.

episodes.name: Day 62: Hits, Flops and Star Stops
episodes.overview: Amala Akkineni and Ram Gopal Varma join Nagarjuna to celebrate Shiva’s return. Audience vote for hits and flops, housemates sacrifice for valuables, while Ramu faces a dilemma.

episodes.name: Day 63: Who’s In, Who’s Out?
episodes.overview: Housemates make bold guesses about who’s heading for the trophy and who’s facing the exit. Nagarjuna steps in to resolve Gaurav’s issue, while two stand on the edge of eviction.

episodes.name: Day 64: Old Scores, New Targets
episodes.overview: Nominations heat up as housemates unleash mud showers, along with  accusations and reasons at each other. Some target the wildcards, while old rivalries spark fiery clashes.

episodes.name: Day 65: Royals Take over the House
episodes.overview: Royal task drama unfolds and housemates vie for powerful roles. Challenges stir arguments, laughter and rivalry under King Kalyan and his queens' watchful eye.

episodes.name: Day 66: Commanders vs Queens
episodes.overview: Kings and Queens revel in dance-offs led by Suman, Bharani, and Emmanuel, followed by a tense domino duel. Royals and Commanders clash, ending with a Baahubali spoof.

episodes.name: Day 67: Royalty, Riots and a Race
episodes.overview: Chef Sanjay brings a royal feast, while hilarious riot for rights erupts, led by Suman and Emmanuel. The day ends with a tense captaincy race to win the crown.

episodes.name: Day 68: A New Captain and Old Memories
episodes.overview: Thanuja, Rithu and Nikhil fight for the crown in a tense captaincy task. Later, emotions flow with childhood stories, but the mood lifts with non-stop fun from Emmanuel and Rithu.

episodes.name: Day 69: Swords, Storms and Shockers
episodes.overview: Swords blaze into fiery symbols as housemates voice bold opinions and Rithu is slammed as the worst Sanchalak. Nag stresses gender gives no privilege as two big weekend bombs loom.

episodes.name: Day 70: Spicy Mirchi Task Sparks Drama
episodes.overview: Laughter fills the BB house during a hilarious mute movie-dialogue game. Tension rises in the mirchi task, and Naga Chaitanya’s surprise entry sparks excitement and fun.

episodes.name: Day 71: Pick, Clash, Repeat
episodes.overview: The house erupts as Captain Thanuja’s twist pushes Emmanuel, Bharani and Rithu into heated conflict. Pavan’s move rattles some, while Suman Shetty keep the drama blazing.

episodes.name: Day 72: Family Week Brings Joy and Tears
episodes.overview: Family Week in the Bigg Boss house sparked emotions as Thanuja’s sister visited with her niece. Suman shared a heartfelt reunion with his wife, enjoying pav bhaji and sweets.

episodes.name: Day 73: Bonds Beyond the Game
episodes.overview: Pavan's mother melts his tough exterior. Sanjana's kids bring joy, while her husband teases her. Later, Divya's mother lifts spirits and forms a sweet bond with Bharani.

episodes.name: Day 74: A Day of Laughter and Love
episodes.overview: Family week continues! Bharani's daughter wishes for his captaincy. Rithu's mother plays a fun game, while Kalyan makes a tearful promise to bring the trophy home.

episodes.name: Day 75: Monster Madness Hits Hard
episodes.overview: The Hungry Monster task throws the house into chaos, ending in shock as Divya slips during a heated debate. Emmanuel’s mother enters, inspiring him to rise from comedian to hero.

episodes.name: Day 76: Bigg Moments, Bigg Emotions
episodes.overview: Family time stirs emotions as Bharani and Kalyan’s parents get teary on stage. Nagarjuna addresses conflicts, while Avinash and Emmanuel’s brother bring fun.

episodes.name: Day 77: Heartfelt Goodbyes
episodes.overview: Pavan, Sanjana, Suman, and Rithu’s family join Nagarjuna, bringing love and laughter. Sanjana and Divya face danger, with Power Astra keeping elimination uncertain.

episodes.name: Day 78: Secret Nominations and Open War
episodes.overview: Secret nominations turn the house into a battlefield. Thanuja clashes with Emmanuel, and Bharani fights Divya. Pavan's vote then ignites further accusations and tension.

episodes.name: Day 79: Flirts and Fun Games
episodes.overview: Gautam Krishna returns to challenge Bharani. Priyanka Jain charms the house with a Fishy game. Later, housemates perform a hilarious flirting skit to entertain the guests.

episodes.name: Day 80: Exhilarating Tasks with Ex-Housemates
episodes.overview: Prerana, Harika and Manas enter the house to challenge the housemates in quirky tasks that test strength and focus. Amid fun and laughter, who will emerge victorious?

episodes.name: Day 81: Fun Unlimited with the Guests
episodes.overview: BB grants Sohail's request in a quirky way, while Prince Yawar’s charm leaves Thanuja blushing. Shoba Shetty throws a challenge at Divya, keeping everyone on edge.

episodes.name: Day 82: Daggers and Difficult Decisions
episodes.overview: Dagger picks reshape alliances and spark intense drama among housemates. Later, the final two contenders fight a draining captaincy task as pressure mounts. Who'll win?

episodes.name: Day 83: War-Zone Task Ignites Rivalries
episodes.overview: Nagarjuna addresses the Rithu-Pavan issue, calling out Sanjana for character assassination. The war-zone task heats up as the housemates choose their enemies and backstabbers.

episodes.name: Day 84: Fun Sunday, Unexpected Tension
episodes.overview: Sunday Funday brings joy as housemates pick movie posters, with Thanuja praising Pavan-Rithu. The mood darkens as they decide which contestant isn’t eligible to stay in BB.

episodes.name: Day 85: Smash to Nominate
episodes.overview: Housemates smash bottles to nominate their targets, sparking new grudges and rifts in friendships. Pavan-Thanuja clash over strategy, while Suman’s goofy reason lightens the mood.

episodes.name: Day 86: Ticket to Finale Week
episodes.overview: Housemates power through tough tasks as the TTF race kicks off! A slip brings Sanjana to tears, while another challenge sparks a fiery clash. Who will emerge as Top 5?

episodes.name: Day 87: Clash for the Top 5 Spot
episodes.overview: Despite the grueling challenges, housemates hold firm with their power play and grit. However, chaos erupts as they clash over selecting 3 contenders for the third TTF challenge.

episodes.name: Day 88: Three Contenders, One Ticket
episodes.overview: Sabotage, stumbles, and tricky challenges make the race intense. Out of the three contenders, only one will rise from the turmoil. Who will claim the TTF?

episodes.name: Day 89: Meet the First Finalist
episodes.overview: The final round pushes Rithu, Suman and Kalyan to their limits, shaken by bias and pressure. Later, the last two clash in the Jayammu Nishchayambu Ra for the first finalist spot.

episodes.name: Day 90: Thumbs Up, Thumbs Down
episodes.overview: Housemates justify why they deserve to win as others give thumbs up or down. Later, Nagarjuna questions unfair gameplay and criticises overconfidence in the house.

episodes.name: Day 91: Game Night with Nagarjuna
episodes.overview: Rithu's math mischief, movie games and Ball-in-Glass pranks stir fun with Nagarjuna in the house. Later, emotions rise as Sanjana and Rithu face eviction. Who will leave?

episodes.name: Day 92: Idhi Fair Kaadhu BB!
episodes.overview: BB drops six cash-prize boxes and asks housemates to argue over who truly deserves the rewards. Emotional rifts emerge and heated debates erupt as the house splits in opinion.

episodes.name: Day 93: Fights, Fun and Fan Fury
episodes.overview: The wheelbarrow task sparks a massive debate over removals, pitting Emmanuel against the house. Later, the audience enters to grill the contestants with bold and funny questions.

episodes.name: Day 94: The Finale Race Intensifies
episodes.overview: Thanuja’s aggression sparks a clash with Kalyan. Sanjana stands her ground against the house. And the drama peaks with a gripping puzzle battle.

episodes.name: Day 95: Bigg Sacrifices
episodes.overview: Suman makes an emotional choice about the prize money. Pavan’s score transfer sparks a row between Thanuja and Bharani. Later, Thanuja and Sanjana fight during the balance task.

episodes.name: Day 96: Breakdown Before the Finale
episodes.overview: The race to secure a spot intensifies with a massive fight breakout between Sanjana and Emmanuel. Later, Thanuja gets injured during a task, leaving Emmanuel crushed by guilt.

episodes.name: Day 97: Double Eviction?
episodes.overview: With prize money slashed and trust flag conflicts erupting, Nagarjuna’s double elimination shocks the house. Later, emotions run high as housemates share regrets and confessions.

episodes.name: Day 98: Sunday Funday with the King
episodes.overview: House turns lively as Nagarjuna kicks off Funday with recreation tasks and endless laughter. Rage Machine's entry brings out secrets, and the race to Top 5 heats up.

episodes.name: Day 99: One Beat Away from the Finale
episodes.overview: The Top 5 get family messages before battling for Player of the Day. After emotional reflections, the Nacho Re dance task tests their stamina in the race to the finale.

episodes.name: Day 100: Pushing Limits in the Finale
episodes.overview: Finalists battle in the hat challenge, where the Sanchalak faces issues. Sanjana wins the next task before an intense showdown, and a Performer of the Day emerges.

episodes.name: Day 101: An Emotional Recap
episodes.overview: Tempers flare during tasks, but heartfelt messages from Sanjana’s family bring warmth. BB walks Emmanuel through his journey, leaving him emotional.

episodes.name: Day 102: Journeys That Defined Them
episodes.overview: Witness Thanuja’s strength and Pavan’s rise from commoner to conqueror as they relive their journeys. Emotions peak as the house feels the pride of the finale!

episodes.name: Day 103: Memories Before the Crown
episodes.overview: Kalyan and Sanjana take a walk down the memory lane and review their journey. A tearful celebration of their struggles and dreams takes over the house as the finale nears.

episodes.name: Day 104: Stars Arrive and Secrets Spill
episodes.overview: Shivaji hosts a game of sink or float while Srinidhi Shetty enters the house spreading charm and cheer. Pradeep and Sreemukhi stir the pot and Emmanuel shares his candid views.

episodes.name: Day 105: Grand Finale
episodes.overview: The most anticipated moment has arrived! With five finalists and one trophy on the line, join Nagarjuna to discover who becomes the winner.

episodes.name: BBTel Day 1: Hidden Power Drop
